## Checklist

- [ ] Brand-agnostic: no real company names, brand values, or confidential material
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this content
- [ ] New or changed rules have a MUST / SHOULD / MAY level and a stable rule ID
- [ ] No MUST rule weakened below WCAG 2.2 AA
- [ ] Brand values stay out of `DESIGN.md` (BRD-5)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Relative links checked
